name: wilderzone-auxiliary
description: Wilderzone Auxiliary Services - auxiliary services for Wilderzone (Tribes 2) game servers: VPN/proxy detection with a web admin panel, and more to come. Cloudflare Worker + D1 + KV.
author: GeekOfWires <GeekOfWires@users.noreply.github.com>

scripts.build: npm --prefix app install && npm run build:app
scripts.db:migrate:local: for f in migrations/*.sql; do wrangler d1 execute wilderzone-aux-db --local --file="$f"; done
scripts.db:migrate: for f in migrations/*.sql; do wrangler d1 execute wilderzone-aux-db --remote --file="$f"; done
